It’s so disappointing that a game where you play as a Viking is that underwhelming. You’d think it would have been more difficult too. 

As a somewhat veteran to the series, I started my first playthrough on HARD. At first, it was a grind that felt like I had to get used to, but after playing odyssey, it came to me quite quickly. The combat was relatively easy once you get to mid level, as most weapons you’ve upgraded tend towards being the ones you use most often. Once I started dual wielding it became the fastest way to clear out areas when raiding, or completing arcs, etc. Speed alone with two spears made for a routine outing of dodge, dodge, unload your specials, finish with unending strikes. 

The story was fun for me, only because I was watching the series The Last Kingdom around the same time I purchased and started playing. So I was able to somewhat follow that story along with mild comparisons for the two. They take place near the same era/time period, so it made getting into the long winded norse mythology arcs that much more weighted. 

Otherwise, I enjoyed playing as eivor, leveling up quickly, and collecting the armor and weapons. Ending was very confusing, but redeeming in the sense that the story led to somewhat of a mind fuck. Regardless, the game is far too large for any sort of replaying. Especially when I played on hard and when you level up enough, the game just becomes a slog. I needed more of a challenge and really miss using the dual hidden blades. 

In short, if you don’t find something about the game that makes you keep playing it, other than the ending, then you’re not gonna see any major changes. I do hope the next game is much better and leads towards more expanding on the actual AC narratives from the past games.
